subject.title: fix: parse provider rate-limit reset timestamps for smarter cooldowns

question: Should OpenClaw accept free-form provider reset timestamp parsing as default auth-profile cooldown input, or require a typed/provider-scoped reset-hint contract first?
rationale: This PR changes default auth-provider recovery behavior for existing setups by deriving long cooldowns from provider error text, and automation cannot decide that product/compatibility policy from tests alone.

options.title: Accept after completing this path
options.body: Approve the broad reset-text parsing direction once assistant propagation, checks, regression coverage, and real-run proof are complete.

options.title: Require a typed reset hint
options.body: Pause this branch and define a provider-scoped reset metadata contract before changing default cooldown behavior.

options.title: Limit to provider-specific handling
options.body: Allow only narrowly documented ZAI/ZhipuAI reset text first and defer generic Retry-After/body parsing to the broader quota work.

recommendation.title: Accept after completing this path
recommendation.body: Approve the broad reset-text parsing direction once assistant propagation, checks, regression coverage, and real-run proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: cxbAsDev is the strongest recent history signal on the auth-profile usage and provider error body handling path affected by this decision.
